narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'office surprise' scenario to promote Logitech's ALTO KEYS K98M mechanical keyboard and POP MOUSE. It showcases the products' aesthetic appeal, silent typing features, and multi-device connectivity under the guise of a boss improving an employee's work efficiency.
